methodologyNotes: Numeric specs use US units: warm time in seconds, power in watts (W), MSRP in USD. Heating method is either 'steam' or 'water-bath'. Auto-shutoff, defrost mode, sterilize mode, fits wide neck, and app control are booleans. Countertop electric warmers only; the Nanobebe Smart Warming Bowl was excluded because it is a non-electric passive warm-water bowl. The Tommee Tippee Quick-Cook Bottle Warmer was excluded because no manufacturer page, ASIN, or spec sheet could be found for that exact product name — Tommee Tippee's US lineup does not include a product by that name. Where a spec was not published on any accessible primary source, the value is null rather than estimated.
